english_draft:
Microsoft published its fiscal year 2027 first quarter results on October 28, 2026. The quarter ended September 30, 2026. This calendar quarter is 2026Q3.

The company-level revenue was USD 92.3 billion. Revenue increased 19 percent year over year. The company-level GAAP operating income was USD 45.9 billion. Operating income increased 21 percent year over year. The derived GAAP operating margin is about 49.7 percent.

No Preview article existed before this earnings date. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare the results with a Preview. The verified fact set did not include company guidance or a reliable market consensus. This analysis does not report an earnings surprise.

The verified facts contain only these totals. They do not include segment revenue, segment profit, or cash flow. Therefore, we cannot verify product-level profit or cash drivers. We mark those items as pending verification.

For the next quarter, which is fiscal year 2027 Q2 and calendar 2026Q4, the official release should be checked for segment revenue, operating margin, capital expenditure, cash flow, and shareholder returns. This analysis makes no numeric forecast.
